description: Activate when: "why isn't the bonus motivating them," "already paid well but disengaged," "what need does this product really serve," "team is in survival mode," "they need to feel safe before caring about the mission," or diagnosing why a standard incentive is failing. Do NOT activate when: formal motivational science is required (use SDT); cross-cultural nuance makes the five-level hierarchy unreliable; precise empirical rank-ordering of needs is load-bearing. More: deciqai.com/c/maslow-hierarchy
